name: Patient $everything (compact bundle)
description: A compact, field-extracted bundle of the patient's clinically relevant resources.

name: Active conditions
spec: {"sql":"SELECT code, clinicalStatus FROM HSFHIR_X0001_S.Condition WHERE patient = '{{patientRef}}' AND clinicalStatus LIKE '%active%'"}
description: Active problem list for the patient (read-only, guarded).

name: Recent abnormal labs
description: Recent laboratory observations and reports for the patient.

name: Payer policy search
description: Native IRIS Vector Search over payer policy documents.

name: Drug interaction guidance search
description: Native IRIS Vector Search over drug-interaction guidance.

name: Diagnosis terminology resolve
description: Resolve a diagnosis phrase to a SNOMED CT code before coded searches.

name: Kidney function (eGFR) results
spec: {"sql":"SELECT o.dateStart AS Observed, vq.value AS eGFR FROM HSFHIR_X0001_S.Observation o JOIN HSFHIR_X0001_S_Observation.valueQuantity vq ON vq.Key = o.Key WHERE o.patient = '{{patientRef}}' AND o.code LIKE '%33914-3%' ORDER BY o.dateStart DESC"}
description: All eGFR results for the patient, newest first (read-only, guarded). Used by the Metformin Renal Safety starter.
